A_2panel_90.description: 2-panel deployable on +y, rotated 90 deg so cells face -x

B_3panel_90.description: 3-panel deployable on +y, rotated 90 deg so cells face -x

C_2panel_135_plus_body.description: 2-panel deployable on +y at a 135 deg dihedral to the +y face, plus one body-mounted panel on the +y face. The wing normal sits 45 deg off +y, so all three panels see the Sun at once. Per-panel power is taken as 14.8/2 = 7.4 W, consistent with the 7.5 W quoted for the body panel.

A_2panel_90.binding_constraint: USB 2.0 bus over the available experiment time

B_3panel_90.binding_constraint: USB 2.0 bus over the available experiment time
